title: Walk to Younger Self
purpose: Primary production preset for September 1 memory films.
structure: 0-2s: school-age version already exists naturally in the school environment
2-6s: adult present-day version enters frame and approaches slowly
6-8s: mutual recognition, brief eye contact, restrained warm reaction
8-10s: subtle stop or half-step closer, emotional final hold

camera.movement: subtle cinematic dolly or very slow handheld drift

motion_rules: adult and child must remain distinct ages
look: premium cinematic realism, restrained nostalgia, authentic school memory, soft September daylight
final_beat: recognition and quiet emotional connection rather than hug by default
